properties.name: arconia.bootstrap.mode
properties.description: The mode used to bootstrap the application (dev, test, prod). It describes the launch context, so it only takes effect as a JVM system property (-Darconia.bootstrap.mode) or as the ARCONIA_BOOTSTRAP_MODE environment variable. When not set, the mode is auto-detected.

properties.name: arconia.bootstrap.profiles.enabled
properties.description: Whether the profiles are enabled based on the application mode. Resolved before the application configuration is loaded, so it is only supported in the META-INF/arconia-bootstrap.properties file, as a JVM system property, as an environment variable, or as a command line argument.

properties.name: arconia.dev.profiles
properties.description: Name of the profiles to activate in development mode. Resolved before the application configuration is loaded, so it is only supported in the META-INF/arconia-bootstrap.properties file, as a JVM system property, as an environment variable, or as a command line argument.

properties.name: arconia.test.profiles
properties.description: Name of the profiles to activate in test mode. Resolved before the application configuration is loaded, so it is only supported in the META-INF/arconia-bootstrap.properties file, as a JVM system property, as an environment variable, or as a command line argument.
